steps.title: Soave
steps.body: Soave suits light Italian food: risotto with spring vegetables, seafood, grilled fish, antipasti and fresh cheeses. Its almond notes suit dishes with nuts, and its saline edge suits shellfish. Aged Soave suits richer fish and white meat.

steps.title: Recioto and service
steps.body: Recioto di Soave suits almond biscuits, pandoro, fruit tarts and blue cheese. Serve Soave at 8 to 10 degrees, Recioto at 10 to 12. Simple Soave is best young; Classico from top sites ages 10 years; Recioto can age decades.
Verona's pandoro, a tall star-shaped cake, and a glass of Recioto di Soave is a local Christmas pairing.

steps.prompt: Recioto di Soave can age for decades.
steps.explanation: Yes. Its sugar and acidity preserve it.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Soave suits risotto, seafood and antipasti
Recioto suits pandoro, biscuits and blue cheese
